producer_role: A2 publishes exact line-prefix/schema and resource list; E adapts parser after formal delivery, no request to edit production from E

requested_effective_header.l2_data_free_effective: masterON=>1; OFF=>0 for these five pairs

capacity_resource_map.required: All actually enlarged resources; exact list from A manifest with nominal/effective capacity, owner/source location, update sites and scope. Include list above when enlarged/applicable. Native cache queue capacities and local frontend capacities must not be confused.
capacity_resource_map.not_applicable: Explicit applicability=false with source reason; do not invent a capacity/hwm/refusal0 for structures not used by traditionalS
capacity_resource_map.unchanged_finite_limits: List separately as remaining bottlenecks. Do not call whole simulator unbounded; classification refers only to named enlarged vector.

each_resource_each_slice_terminal_fields.highwater: measured max occupancy over COMPLETE input, including memcpy/initial state if in bound
each_resource_each_slice_terminal_fields.capacity_refusals: all rejects solely from this capacity with source-defined increment sites
each_resource_each_slice_terminal_fields.counter_covered: 1 only if every relevant increment/occupancy update path instrumented
each_resource_each_slice_terminal_fields.terminal_used: actual live at final drain where expected to empty
each_resource_each_slice_terminal_fields.units: entries/slots; per-address maximum over addresses with explicit scope

important_counter_rules: Plain cache miss is not automatically a capacity refusal; document exact pending-tag/no-victim/admission limit reason
Do not substitute wait observations for true refused admission count without exact increment coverage
Avoid uint32 overflow; use uint64 or proven sufficient bound
Highwater cumulative max from actual structure, not final_used=0
One header alone is insufficient if 64slice getters can disagree; record every slice
Refusal>0 or highwater>50% is valid large-finite diagnostic, not correctness failure; missing coverage means UNKNOWN
